summary: Comprehensive Security Audit of MeetFlow Platform - Pen-Test Style Assessment. Overall Security Rating: B. Found 0 CRITICAL, 0 HIGH, 3 MEDIUM, 2 LOW, and several INFO findings. The platform demonstrates good security practices with proper JWT handling, rate limiting, NoSQL injection protection, and RBAC enforcement. Main areas for improvement: CORS configuration, security headers, and push subscription authentication.

medium.issue: CORS allows any origin (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *). While credentials are not allowed with wildcard, this is still permissive.
medium.impact: Data may be accessible from any website via CORS
medium.recommendation: Restrict CORS to specific trusted origins (FRONTEND_URL only)

medium.issue: Push subscription endpoint returns 200 without authentication
medium.impact: Potential for unlimited push subscriptions (DoS vector)
medium.recommendation: Require authentication for push subscription endpoints

medium.issue: Password reset tokens are logged in backend logs
medium.impact: Password reset tokens could be extracted from logs
medium.recommendation: Remove password reset token logging or mask tokens in logs

low.issue: Missing security headers: X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Strict-Transport-Security, Content-Security-Policy, Referrer-Policy
low.reproduction: GET any API endpoint and check response headers
low.impact: Various client-side attacks may be easier
low.recommendation: Add recommended security headers via middleware

low.issue: Logout sets cookies with secure=False and samesite=lax instead of matching login attributes
low.impact: Cookie attributes inconsistent between login and logout

info.issue: WebSocket endpoint /api/ws/{meeting_id}/{user_id} does not validate JWT token on connect
info.reproduction: Connect to WS with arbitrary user_id
info.recommendation: Add token validation on WebSocket connect

info.issue: No /api/users/me/export endpoint found for DSGVO Art. 20 data portability
info.recommendation: Implement data export functionality for DSGVO compliance

security_checks_passed.details: Tampered JWT tokens are correctly rejected with 401
Tokens with alg:none are rejected
No password_hash field in /auth/me response (regression fix verified)
No password_hash field in login response
No _id field exposed in API responses
Cookies have HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite attributes
Rate limiting active - 429 returned after multiple failed attempts
token_version mechanism properly invalidates old tokens
Same message returned for existing and non-existing emails
Same error message for wrong password and non-existing user
Member cannot access admin endpoints (403 returned)
host-control endpoint properly checks for host/co-host role
Non-admin cannot delete users (403 returned)
MongoDB operator injection blocked (422 returned)
Path traversal attempts blocked (404 returned)
Large payloads handled gracefully
Random diag tokens return 404
Chat files require authentication
Only image types allowed for avatar upload
bcrypt.gensalt() uses default 12 rounds
JWT_SECRET is not the default value

action_items: MEDIUM: Restrict CORS to specific trusted origins instead of wildcard
MEDIUM: Add authentication requirement to /api/news/push/subscribe endpoint
MEDIUM: Remove or mask password reset tokens in log output
LOW: Add security headers middleware (X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, etc.)
LOW: Fix logout cookie attributes to match login (secure=True, samesite=none)
INFO: Consider adding JWT validation to WebSocket connections
INFO: Implement DSGVO data export endpoint (/api/users/me/export)
critical_code_review_comments: CORS_ORIGINS='*' in .env - should be restricted to FRONTEND_URL only
Password reset token logged at INFO level in auth.py line 306
WebSocket endpoint accepts any user_id without token validation
Logout cookie attributes differ from login (secure=False vs True)
No security headers middleware configured in server.py
context_for_next_testing_agent: Security audit completed. Main findings: (1) CORS allows any origin - fix in server.py, (2) Push subscribe lacks auth - fix in news routes, (3) Password reset tokens logged - fix in auth.py. All critical security controls (JWT, RBAC, injection protection, rate limiting) are working correctly. Platform is secure for production with the recommended fixes.
security_rating_explanation: Rating B indicates good security posture with minor issues. No critical or high severity vulnerabilities found. The platform properly implements: JWT authentication, session management, RBAC, NoSQL injection protection, rate limiting, and password hashing. Recommended improvements are mostly hardening measures.
